post.summary: Suno Voice Generate Verification Phrase API
post.description:
:::warning Document updated
If you have already completed the integration process previously, you can still access the old version document at: Old version address (https://docs.kie.ai/old-model/suno-api/suno-voice-validate)
:::

Generate a validation phrase for the Suno Voice custom voice workflow.

Submit the source audio URL and the selected vocal segment. The system will analyze the source voice and create a validation phrase that the user needs to read in the next step.

:::tip
This endpoint is free.
:::

## Query Task Status
:::tip[]
In the production environment, it is recommended to use the `callBackUrl` parameter to receive automatic notifications when the validation phrase is ready, rather than polling the status endpoint.
:::

## Next Step

After the validation phrase is ready, ask the user to read the phrase and upload the recorded verification audio to continue creating the voice.

model.description: The model name to use for generation. Required field.

callBackUrl.description:
The URL to receive generation task completion updates. Optional but recommended for production use.

- System will POST task status and results to this URL when generation completes
- Callback includes generated content URLs and task information
- Your callback endpoint should accept POST requests with JSON payload containing results
- Alternatively, use the Get Task Details endpoint to poll task status
- To ensure callback security, see [Webhook Verification Guide](/common-api/webhook-verification) for signature verification implementation

input.description: Input parameters for the generation task

voice_url.description: The original recording URL uploaded by the user [Required]

vocal_start_s.description: Start time (in seconds) for extracting the vocal segment [Required]

vocal_end_s.description: End time (in seconds) for extracting the vocal segment, must be greater than vocal_start_s [Required]

language.description: Verify the language of the short phrase. Supported languages ​​include: English (en), Chinese (zh), Spanish (es), French (fr), Portuguese (pt), German (de), Japanese (ja), Korean (ko), Hindi (hi), and Russian (ru).

code.description: Status code of the request. The HTTP status is 200 even when the request fails, so always check this field: 200 means success; any other value means the request failed and msg describes the reason. Common values: 401 invalid or missing API key; 402 insufficient credits; 429 rate limit exceeded; 422 or 500 the request could not be processed (read msg and check your parameters before retrying).

BearerAuth.description: All API requests require a Bearer Token. Add the header `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` to authenticate requests.
